name: Kedesh
line: Kedesh was a city of refuge in Naphtali's hill country in Galilee, where Barak gathered his army and which Assyria later captured.

moments.title: A city of refuge
moments.text: Israel set apart Kedesh in Galilee as one of the cities of refuge. Someone who killed another person by accident could flee there and be safe from the avenger of blood.

moments.title: Deborah and Barak gather the army
moments.text: Deborah went with Barak to Kedesh, where he called together the men of Zebulun and Naphtali. Ten thousand men followed him, and Deborah went too.

moments.title: Captured by Assyria
moments.text: In the days of King Pekah, Tiglath-pileser of Assyria captured Kedesh and the land of Naphtali. He took the people to Assyria as captives.
